metadata.name: Hawkeye
metadata.description: Phoenix Hawkeye: read-only view program for Phoenix Eternal margin, liquidation, BBO, funding state, and order matching quotes

docs: Manual Anchor-compatible IDL for the Phoenix Hawkeye view program.
Instruction data uses an eight-byte little-endian Phoenix discriminator followed by repr(C) POD params, except ViewOrderQuote which takes a u64 reference price followed by a Borsh OrderPacket.
Return data is raw repr(C) POD bytes. Decode the first eight bytes as little-endian magic, then decode the matching return struct in types[].
GlobalTraderIndex and ActiveTraderBuffer are variable-length account groups. Flatten every account from the exchange cache at the documented position before appending the remaining accounts.

instructions.name: ViewOrderQuote
docs: Quotes the existing matching engine against copied state. Does not predict taker margin or authority checks.
Returns fills, gross notional, fees, posted and unfilled quantities, average price, optional slippage, effective size, posted price, outcome and rejection reason.

cancelExisting returns unsupported. Expected matching rejections return successfully with zero retained fills, fees and posts; malformed input, invalid accounts and runtime failures remain instruction errors.

accounts.name: scratch
docs: Zero-lamport Hawkeye-owned buffer, allocated by a preceding top-level System instruction in the same transaction. Closed on success.
Must fit aligned copies of all source accounts and arena growth for taker activation and spline positions. Insufficient capacity fails the instruction.

args.name: referencePriceTicks
docs: Zero omits slippage; otherwise slippage is measured against this price, excluding fees.

args.name: orderPacket
docs: OrderPacket contains only its kind field, so its Borsh encoding is identical to OrderPacketKind.

types.name: ViewAssetParams
docs: repr(C) asset parameter payload.
Instruction data layout after discriminator: assetId:u32, padding:[u8;4].

types.name: ViewMarginReturn
docs: Return data for ViewMargin. Size: 112 bytes.
riskState values: 0=Healthy, 1=Unhealthy, 2=Underwater, 3=ZeroCollateralNoPositions.
riskTier values: 0=Safe, 1=AtRisk, 2=Cancellable, 3=Liquidatable, 4=BackstopLiquidatable, 5=HighRisk.

fields.name: magic
docs: Little-endian u64 magic for return:phoenix_hawkeye_margin.

fields.name: isLiquidatable
docs: 0=false, 1=true.

types.name: ViewAssetReturn
docs: Return data for ViewMarginForAsset. Size: 128 bytes.
riskState values: 0=Healthy, 1=Unhealthy, 2=Underwater, 3=ZeroCollateralNoPositions.
riskTier values: 0=Safe, 1=AtRisk, 2=Cancellable, 3=Liquidatable, 4=BackstopLiquidatable, 5=HighRisk.

fields.name: magic
docs: Little-endian u64 magic for return:phoenix_hawkeye_asset.

fields.name: hasPositionOrOrders
docs: 0=false, 1=true.

types.name: ViewLiquidationPriceReturn
docs: Return data for ViewLiquidationPrice. Size: 56 bytes.
status values: 0=NoPosition, 1=Found, 2=AlreadyLiquidatable, 3=NoPriceInBounds.
side values: 0=NoneOrFlat, 1=Long, 2=Short.

fields.name: magic
docs: Little-endian u64 magic for return:phoenix_hawkeye_liquidation_price.

fields.name: liquidationPriceTicks
docs: Zero when status has no liquidation price.

types.name: ViewBboReturn
docs: Return data for ViewBbo. Size: 64 bytes.
flags bit 0 means bestBidTicks is present. flags bit 1 means bestAskTicks is present.
When the corresponding flag is not set, bestBidTicks or bestAskTicks is zero and should be treated as None.

fields.name: magic
docs: Little-endian u64 magic for return:phoenix_hawkeye_bbo.

types.name: ViewFundingReturn
docs: Return data for ViewFunding. Size: 48 bytes.
flags bit 0 means totalAccumulatedFundingQuoteLots is present. flags bit 1 means totalUnsettledFundingQuoteLots is present.
When a funding flag is not set, the corresponding quote-lots field is zero and should be treated as None.
Funding rates are signed micro-basis-points to avoid floating point arithmetic. Divide by 10000 to get basis points.

fields.name: magic
docs: Little-endian u64 magic for return:phoenix_hawkeye_funding.

types.name: ViewOrderQuoteReturn
docs: Size: 120 bytes. flags: bit 0 average price, bit 1 slippage, bit 2 effective size present. side: 0=bid, 1=ask.
filledQuoteLots is gross, excluding fees. unfilledBaseLots includes any posted remainder.
Average price rounds down to quote lots per base lot. Slippage is signed basis points rounded toward zero; positive means adverse execution.
Matching acceptance does not establish taker margin or authority checks. Expected rejections return success with zero retained fills, fees and posts.
effectiveBaseLots is the size after reduce-only clamping; absent for rejected, unsupported or expired orders. postedPriceTicks is valid when postedBaseLots is nonzero and includes post-only sliding.
outcome: 0=accepted, 1=rejected, 2=unsupported. Use placement limits to enforce execution constraints.

rejectionReason: 0=none, 1=cancelExisting, 2=invalidOrderPacket, 3=minimumFillNotMet, 4=selfTradeAbort, 5=postOnlyCross, 6=reduceOnlyIncreaseExposure, 7=tooManyLimitOrders, 8=insufficientAggression, 9=invalidTimeInForce, 10=zeroPrice, 11=zeroSize, 12=outsideExecutionPriceBand, 13=expired.

types.name: OrderPacket
docs: Serialized parameters for Phoenix order placement instructions.

types.name: OrderPacketKind
docs: Supported order variants accepted by the Phoenix matching engine.

types.name: Side
docs: Trading direction for an order.

types.name: Ticks
docs: Discrete price unit measured in quote lots per base lot.

types.name: BaseLots
docs: Quantity wrapper representing discrete base lots.

types.name: OrderFlags
docs: Bitmask flags applied to an order: bit 7 reduce-only, bit 6 stop-loss, bit 5 conditional-order, bit 4 stop-loss-direction, bit 3 clear-on-position-flip.

types.name: SelfTradeBehavior
docs: Policy for handling matches against the submitting trader's resting orders.

types.name: QuoteLots
docs: Quantity wrapper representing discrete quote lots.
